source_caption:
🎬 American Underdog (2021)

American Underdog follows the inspiring true story of Kurt Warner, a talented football player whose dreams of becoming an NFL quarterback seem almost impossible to achieve. After going undrafted and facing repeated setbacks in his professional career, Kurt struggles to support himself while working at a grocery store and refusing to abandon his passion for football. Along the way, he meets Brenda, a strong and independent single mother whose love and encouragement become an important part of his journey. As Kurt balances family responsibilities, financial struggles, and opportunities to continue playing football, he faces countless obstacles that test his determination and belief in himself. Despite being overlooked by professional teams, he continues working toward his dream until an unexpected opportunity with the St. Louis Rams changes his life. Combining emotional storytelling, inspiring sports action, and heartfelt family moments, the film explores perseverance, faith, love, sacrifice, and the importance of never giving up on your dreams.

🎭 Genre: Biography • Drama • Sports

⭐ IMDb: 7.1/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 52m • PG

🎥 Directors: Andrew Erwin and Jon Erwin

🏆 Recognition: Starring Zachary Levi, Anna Paquin, Dennis Quaid, and Ser’Darius Blain, the film tells the remarkable journey of NFL quarterback Kurt Warner, who went from stocking grocery shelves to becoming a Super Bowl champion and NFL MVP. Based on Warner’s life and memoir, the film received recognition for its uplifting message, emotional performances, and portrayal of one of football’s most extraordinary underdog stories.

source_details.synopsis: American Underdog is a 2021 American biographical sports film about National Football League (NFL) quarterback Kurt Warner. Directed by Andrew and Jon Erwin, the film follows Warner's journey as an undrafted player who ascended to winning Super Bowl XXXIV. It stars Zachary Levi as Warner, alongside Anna Paquin as his wife Brenda and Dennis Quaid as his head coach Dick Vermeil. The film was released theatrically in the United States on December 25, 2021, by Lionsgate. It received mostly positive reviews from critics but was a box-office bomb. American Underdog was nominated for the GMA Dove Award for Inspirational Film/Series of the Year at the 2022 GMA Dove Awards.
